decisions.document_creation_timing: create a real fallback-named Markdown file before navigation
decisions.title_presentation: persistent basename text field above document content in preview and edit modes
decisions.title_commit: submit on Return or focus loss; never rename on each keystroke
decisions.blank_title: reuse localized FileStore fallback and collision numbering
decisions.rename_authority: DocumentLibraryController and FileStore remain the only mutation and naming authorities
decisions.automatic_title_source: for a newly created fallback-named document only, reuse shared ATX parsing and accept the first physical line when it is H1 through H3
decisions.automatic_title_priority: a successful explicit non-empty name disables automatic naming; a blank name keeps eligibility; successful inferred rename runs once after content save
decisions.automatic_title_failure: keep saved content and fallback filename, retain eligibility, and retry on a later save
